stem: A platform team wants personalized improvement suggestions based on its existing Azure resources. Which service best fits?

choices.A: Azure Service Health
choices.B: Azure Advisor
choices.C: Azure Resource Health
choices.D: Azure Activity log

explanations.A: Service Health communicates relevant Azure service incidents and maintenance.
explanations.B: Advisor evaluates supported deployment configurations and usage to recommend improvements.
explanations.C: Resource Health reports the availability of an individual supported resource.
explanations.D: The Activity log records management events rather than recommending deployment optimizations.

stem: An Advisor suggestion identifies a potential way to reduce spending on underused capacity. Which category applies?

choices.A: Security
choices.B: Reliability
choices.C: Operational excellence
choices.D: Cost

explanations.A: Security recommendations concern threats and protection rather than the stated spending goal.
explanations.B: Reliability recommendations focus on service continuity.
explanations.C: Operational excellence focuses on operational practices and manageability.
explanations.D: The purpose of the suggestion is to optimize expenditure.

stem: A recommendation proposes reducing a single point of failure for a business-critical workload. Which Advisor category best matches?

choices.A: Reliability
choices.B: Cost
choices.C: Performance
choices.D: Operational excellence

explanations.A: The recommendation aims to improve continuity when a component fails.
explanations.B: A change may affect cost, but reducing a single point of failure addresses continuity.
explanations.C: Performance concerns speed and efficiency rather than this failure-survival requirement.
explanations.D: Operational practices can help, but the stated outcome is reliability.

stem: Which Advisor category most directly concerns recommendations about protection against threats and vulnerabilities?

choices.A: Cost
choices.B: Performance
choices.C: Security
choices.D: Reliability

explanations.A: Cost recommendations target expenditure rather than threat exposure.
explanations.B: Performance recommendations target speed and workload efficiency.
explanations.C: Security recommendations address protection weaknesses.
explanations.D: Reliability targets continuity and recovery rather than the stated protection objective.

stem: A recommendation targets a supported resource configuration that could improve application speed. Which Advisor category is the closest match?

choices.A: Cost
choices.B: Security
choices.C: Performance
choices.D: Reliability

explanations.A: A lower bill is a different outcome from the specified performance improvement.
explanations.B: The scenario gives no threat or access-control objective.
explanations.C: The improvement concerns application or resource speed.
explanations.D: Keeping a service operating during failure is distinct from making it faster.

stem: An Advisor recommendation concerns deployment practices and resource manageability. Which category is intended for that operational goal?

choices.A: Operational excellence
choices.B: Reliability
choices.C: Cost
choices.D: Security

explanations.A: This category addresses process efficiency, manageability, and deployment practices.
explanations.B: Reliability focuses on continuity of business-critical workloads.
explanations.C: Cost focuses on optimizing expenditure.
explanations.D: Security focuses on protection against threats and weaknesses.

stem: Advisor proposes a configuration change for a production workload. What should the owner do before implementing it?

choices.A: Treat the recommendation as proof the workload has already changed
choices.B: Assume every recommendation overrides organizational policy
choices.C: Skip application testing because Advisor evaluates Azure resources
choices.D: Evaluate workload constraints and test the proposed change

explanations.A: A suggestion is not evidence that its action has been executed.
explanations.B: A recommendation does not grant an exemption from policy.
explanations.C: Resource analysis does not prove a custom application's behavior after a change.
explanations.D: Recommendations need assessment against business needs, dependencies, and change controls.

stem: A suggested resize could save money, but the application has a scheduled monthly traffic peak. What evidence matters before approving the change?

choices.A: Only whether the recommendation has a Cost category
choices.B: Capacity and performance during representative peak demand
choices.C: Only the application's current resource-group name
choices.D: Only the latest public Azure Status report

explanations.A: The category identifies its goal but does not establish workload capacity.
explanations.B: Peak requirements can invalidate a resize that appears suitable during quieter usage.
explanations.C: Naming does not demonstrate performance under load.
explanations.D: Platform incident status does not establish the application's required instance size.

stem: An empty training subscription returns no Advisor recommendations. What is the most justified conclusion?

choices.A: Every Azure service is currently available worldwide
choices.B: The subscription's future workloads will have zero cost
choices.C: The application has passed a load test
choices.D: There are no returned findings in the inspected context

explanations.A: Advisor results are not a global service-status report.
explanations.B: Absence of recommendations says nothing about future consumption.
explanations.C: Advisor does not turn an empty list into application test evidence.
explanations.D: An empty result does not certify every possible architecture or future workload.

stem: Which built-in role can provide read access to Advisor recommendations at an appropriate supported scope?

choices.A: Only Owner
choices.B: Reader
choices.C: Only User Access Administrator
choices.D: Storage Blob Data Reader alone

explanations.A: Advisor read access is not restricted to ownership of the subscription.
explanations.B: Reader can access recommendations without needing resource-write permissions.
explanations.C: Role-assignment administration is not the only route to reading recommendations.
explanations.D: Blob data permissions alone do not provide management access to Advisor.

stem: Which command is appropriate for this lab's inspection of existing Advisor recommendations?

choices.A: az advisor recommendation list without --refresh
choices.B: az advisor recommendation disable
choices.C: az advisor recommendation enable
choices.D: az advisor recommendation list --refresh

explanations.A: Listing existing recommendations supports a read-only exercise.
explanations.B: Disable changes the recommendation's state.
explanations.C: Enable changes the recommendation's state.
explanations.D: Refresh requests generation of new recommendations and is excluded from the read-only exercise.

stem: The Advisor CLI exposes a category called HighAvailability while the portal discusses reliability. How should a learner interpret the category in this context?

choices.A: It means all returned recommendations concern security
choices.B: It proves a resource is available at the current instant
choices.C: It is the CLI's reliability-related category label
choices.D: It proves every listed workload already survives a regional failure

explanations.A: The category does not become a security category because its wording differs.
explanations.B: A recommendation category is not an individual resource-health observation.
explanations.C: The current CLI accepted category labels can differ from the portal's terminology.
explanations.D: A recommendation does not certify an architecture's existing resilience.

stem: After an approved improvement is implemented, an old Advisor recommendation still appears briefly. What is a reasonable explanation?

choices.A: The retained recommendation proves the CLI command never executed
choices.B: The improvement changed the subscription to a private cloud
choices.C: Advisor automatically reverted the application code
choices.D: Advisor may need time to recognize the change

explanations.A: Recommendation persistence alone does not establish whether the operation ran.
explanations.B: Recommendation processing does not alter Azure's deployment model.
explanations.C: The overview does not imply automatic reversal of custom application changes.
explanations.D: Recommendation evaluation is not necessarily an immediate transaction confirmation.

stem: A learner can read an Advisor recommendation but cannot change the target resource. What does that demonstrate?

choices.A: Advisor grants temporary Owner permissions with each recommendation
choices.B: Every Advisor finding must be implemented through blob-data permissions
choices.C: Reading advice and applying its action require different permissions
choices.D: The recommended action has already been approved by the organization

explanations.A: A recommendation does not grant subscription ownership.
explanations.B: Resource changes are management operations, not necessarily storage data operations.
explanations.C: Read access does not grant the management permissions needed for a resource change.
explanations.D: Visibility of a recommendation is not organizational change approval.

stem: Which information is central to Advisor's personalized deployment-improvement recommendations?

choices.A: Supported resource configuration and usage telemetry
choices.B: Only public reports of widespread Azure outages
choices.C: Only individual VM availability states
choices.D: Only the text of a resource's display name

explanations.A: Advisor uses resource characteristics and observed usage to identify opportunities.
explanations.B: Public outage notices belong to Azure Status and are not Advisor's core deployment analysis.
explanations.C: Resource Health availability is a different primary capability.
explanations.D: A display name alone is not sufficient configuration and usage analysis.

stem: A visitor without subscription context wants a broad public report about widespread Azure service disruption. Which view is most appropriate?

choices.A: Azure Advisor
choices.B: Azure Status
choices.C: Resource Health for one VM
choices.D: Application Insights for a single application

explanations.A: Advisor provides personalized improvement recommendations rather than a public outage report.
explanations.B: Azure Status provides the public global service-health view.
explanations.C: An individual resource's availability is narrower than a broad service disruption.
explanations.D: Application telemetry does not provide the public global Azure status view.

stem: An administrator wants maintenance information relevant to the services and regions used by the organization's subscription. Which view best fits?

choices.A: Azure Service Health
choices.B: Azure Status alone
choices.C: Azure Advisor Cost category
choices.D: A single VM's Resource Health only

explanations.A: Service Health provides personalized incident, maintenance, and advisory information.
explanations.B: The broad public view is less tailored to the subscription's particular services.
explanations.C: Cost recommendations are not personalized maintenance communications.
explanations.D: One resource's availability is narrower than maintenance affecting used services and regions.

stem: An operator needs the reported availability state of one supported VM instance. Which view is the closest match?

choices.A: Azure Advisor Performance category
choices.B: Azure Status
choices.C: Azure Cost Management
choices.D: Azure Resource Health

explanations.A: Performance suggestions are not that VM's current availability report.
explanations.B: A global status view is broader than an individual instance's availability.
explanations.C: Cost analysis does not report the instance's availability state.
explanations.D: Resource Health addresses individual supported resource availability.

stem: The public Azure Status page shows no widespread issue, but a subscription has a relevant service incident. What should the operator inspect next?

choices.A: Only the Advisor Cost recommendations
choices.B: Only the subscription's naming convention
choices.C: Service Health for the affected subscription
choices.D: A reservation purchase

explanations.A: Cost recommendations do not provide the affected subscription's incident communications.
explanations.B: Resource names do not establish service-health state.
explanations.C: Personalized health information can cover relevant issues beyond a broad public report.
explanations.D: A billing commitment is not an incident diagnostic view.

stem: Resource Health reports a VM available, but users receive application errors. What is the appropriate next investigation?

choices.A: Close the incident because the VM availability report certifies all application code
choices.B: Application request, dependency, and error telemetry
choices.C: Assume the Azure Status page must show the specific exception
choices.D: Use Advisor findings as a complete request trace

explanations.A: Individual resource availability is not application correctness certification.
explanations.B: Platform availability does not prove that the hosted application functions correctly.
explanations.C: The public platform view does not contain every custom application's error.
explanations.D: Deployment recommendations do not replace request-level telemetry.

stem: What additional configuration turns relevant health information into proactive notifications through chosen channels?

choices.A: Service Health alerts and their notification routing
choices.B: Only opening Azure Status in a browser once
choices.C: Only reading an Advisor recommendation
choices.D: Only assigning a resource-group tag

explanations.A: Alerts can notify the responsible recipients about relevant health changes.
explanations.B: A one-time page visit does not configure proactive delivery.
explanations.C: A read operation does not create a health notification rule.
explanations.D: A tag does not itself configure alert conditions or destinations.

stem: Service Health communicates planned maintenance affecting a used service. What useful response can the workload owner plan?

choices.A: Assume Service Health has automatically redesigned the application
choices.B: Assume the maintenance notice is a bill for consumed capacity
choices.C: Assess impact and prepare the workload's response procedure
choices.D: Ignore application dependencies because a notice exists

explanations.A: Health communication does not implement an application's recovery design.
explanations.B: A service-health communication is not a usage invoice.
explanations.C: The communication supplies information for proactive resilience and operational planning.
explanations.D: Dependencies still determine how the workload is affected.

stem: Which information can Service Health communicate in addition to current incidents?

choices.A: Only completed application load-test results
choices.B: Planned maintenance and health advisories
choices.C: Only blob-level access audit records
choices.D: Only predicted application revenue

explanations.A: Custom test results are not the health service's described primary information.
explanations.B: Service Health includes upcoming maintenance and relevant advisories.
explanations.C: Those are workload data events rather than the stated service-health communications.
explanations.D: Business revenue forecasting is outside the described health view.

stem: Which statement best distinguishes Azure Status from personalized Service Health?

choices.A: Azure Status is an individual VM availability checker; Service Health is a pricing calculator
choices.B: Azure Status automatically repairs code; Service Health only reports spending
choices.C: Azure Status replaces every application metric; Service Health changes every resource configuration
choices.D: Azure Status is a broad public view; Service Health is relevant to used subscription services and regions

explanations.A: Those descriptions confuse Resource Health and cost analysis.
explanations.B: Neither description matches the services' stated health capabilities.
explanations.C: Health communications do not replace application telemetry or automatically alter resources.
explanations.D: The views differ in audience and health scope.

stem: When investigating a Service Health event, which scope details are relevant to whether it affects the workload?

choices.A: Only the application's resource-group tags
choices.B: Only the latest cost recommendation category
choices.C: Only the storage account's blob access tier
choices.D: Affected services and regions together with the subscription context

explanations.A: Tags can organize resources but do not establish the event's affected service and region scope.
explanations.B: Optimization advice is not the incident's affected-service scope.
explanations.C: An access tier alone does not identify the event's affected services and regions.
explanations.D: Personalized impact must be compared with the workload's actual Azure usage.

stem: Which expectation about health information would be incorrect?

choices.A: Resource Health can help investigate one supported resource
choices.B: Azure Status can help identify widespread platform issues
choices.C: Receiving a Service Health notice automatically repairs the workload
choices.D: Service Health can communicate maintenance relevant to used services

explanations.A: That is a legitimate individual-resource health use.
explanations.B: That is a legitimate broad public health use.
explanations.C: A notice informs responders; application recovery still requires an appropriate design and action.
explanations.D: That is part of the personalized health capability.

stem: A query filters ServiceHealth events from only the latest 100 retrieved Activity log records and returns nothing. What conclusion is justified?

choices.A: No matching events occurred in that retrieved sample
choices.B: No Azure incident has ever affected the subscription
choices.C: The account's permissions grant access to every application's request logs
choices.D: All planned maintenance notices have been canceled

explanations.A: The time window and record cap limit the inference; this is not proof of uninterrupted service.
explanations.B: A bounded sample cannot establish an unlimited historical claim.
explanations.C: Activity log permission does not imply all workload data access.
explanations.D: A filtered empty sample does not establish cancellation of future maintenance.

stem: A dashboard must show both regional incident communications and one supported resource's availability. Which pair fits those scopes?

choices.A: Advisor Cost and a pricing calculator
choices.B: Service Health and Resource Health
choices.C: Resource tags and storage access tiers
choices.D: Only Application Insights request counts

explanations.A: Those analyze optimization and estimates rather than the requested health scopes.
explanations.B: One addresses relevant service incidents; the other addresses an individual resource.
explanations.C: Those are metadata and storage choices, not the requested health experiences.
explanations.D: Application request telemetry alone does not provide both platform-health scopes.

stem: Two applications use the same Azure service during an incident but experience different user impact. What should be considered?

choices.A: Service Health guarantees identical impact for every application
choices.B: Each application's dependencies, resilience, and actual telemetry
choices.C: The less affected application must use a different subscription billing model
choices.D: Advisor categories determine the exact count of failed user requests

explanations.A: A service incident does not make all customer workload designs identical.
explanations.B: Platform incident information must be interpreted alongside each workload's architecture and behavior.
explanations.C: Billing model alone does not establish outage resilience.
explanations.D: Recommendation categories are not request-level incident measurements.

stem: Which incident report combines appropriate evidence rather than relying on one health view alone?

choices.A: Relevant Service Health communication plus resource and application observations over the incident window
choices.B: Only a screenshot of an empty Advisor Cost list
choices.C: Only the fact that a VM resource name exists
choices.D: Only a global status page checked outside the incident window

explanations.A: Correlating platform scope with workload behavior supports a grounded investigation.
explanations.B: The absence of cost suggestions is not an incident diagnosis.
explanations.C: Resource existence does not establish application health.
explanations.D: A broad view at another time is insufficient for the workload's incident evidence.
